plan.title: Recreate Order with Empty Optional Fields

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid.
Open the RFQ stage specified by the case.
Reach the Responses tab where the Settings menu is available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order window is open before submitting the empty form.
Submit with the dialog's optional fields left at their empty defaults.
Observe any validation, warning, success, or other application message produced by the empty submission.
Check whether the Recreate Order window remains open after the empty submission.
